items.title: Deprecate `tool.uv.dev-dependencies`
items.reason: astral-sh/uv#15406 is the direct precursor: it requested a warning that the field was deprecated and would be removed in a future breaking release. It completed the deprecation phase, while this issue tracks the distinct removal phase.

items.title: Support for PEP 735
items.reason: astral-sh/uv#8272 introduced the standardized `[dependency-groups]` replacement. Its future-work list explicitly included warning about `tool.uv.dev-dependencies`, confirming the intended migration path toward eventual removal.

items.title: Support for PEP 735: Dependency Groups in `pyproject.toml`
items.reason: astral-sh/uv#8090 tracked adoption of dependency groups and discussed whether the `dev` group would supersede `tool.uv.dev-dependencies`; it provides the canonical background for the replacement now motivating removal.

related.search_scope: Searched open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged pull requests using the exact identifiers `tool.uv.dev-dependencies` and `dev-dependencies`, combined with `dependency-groups`, PEP 735, removal, deprecation, warnings, legacy terminology, and dropping support. Inspected the strongest candidates and their comments and linked discussions, including astral-sh/uv#15406, astral-sh/uv#8090, astral-sh/uv#8272, and astral-sh/uv#15557. astral-sh/uv#5340 was ruled out as merely changing whether `uv init` emitted an empty legacy section, not removing support. astral-sh/uv#15557 was also not included because it primarily renamed internal concepts and only referenced the deprecation discussion.

type_reason: This requests an intentional breaking removal of legacy functionality now superseded by standardized dependency groups. It is not a duplicate of astral-sh/uv#15406: that issue completed the earlier deprecation-and-warning phase and explicitly deferred removal to a future release, which is the separate work tracked here.
summary: The closest history is the completed deprecation request astral-sh/uv#15406 and the PEP 735 implementation and discussion in astral-sh/uv#8272 and astral-sh/uv#8090. No existing issue or pull request was found that already tracks the actual removal phase.
